title: evan-brooks-devx-sdk-daily-scratchpad-2026-03-04
content:
Daily scratchpad - SDK docs / sample app fixes (quick brain dump)
Date: 2026-03-04
Owner: Evan Brooks

Top priorities for next week:
- Finish minimal "hello redwood" JS + Python sample apps for hosted API quickstart. Current gaps: authentication flow example for Dedicated + Private (KMS snippet missing), and explicit env var list for both modes.
- Doc gap: streaming responses example in SDKs. JS shows streaming but Python SDK guide has only polling example. Need aligned examples for both.
- Tutorial fix: function/tool-calling tutorial broken sample (step 4) — runtime response schema updated in model catalog; example payload needs updating.

Todo (short):
- [ ] Update README in sdk-samples repo with Dedicated auth example (Devon to review)
- [ ] Add streaming snippet to python-sdk quickstart (target: 1 small code cell)
- [ ] Replace function-calling sample payload in tutorial page (Confluence DEVX-SDK-TUTORIALS-2026)
- [ ] Create a tiny end-to-end sample that demonstrates: hosted -> streaming -> tool call -> structured output -> rollback behavior (can be single-file node app)
- [ ] Add note about model aliasing and rollout policy in quickstart (users often confused about pinning vs alias)

Notes / observations:
- User feedback from last week's support tickets: people copy the JS sample but forget to set REDWOOD_API_KEY in CI. Add CI snippet (GitHub Actions) showing secrets usage.
- Sample apps currently assume modern Node (>=18). Add compatibility note and a tiny alternate code path for older Node (fetch polyfill).
- Docs site search ranking: streaming guide not surfacing well; might need an extra H2 and short meta description.

Specific code hints to add:
- JS streaming example: show usage with fetch + async iterator and also SDK stream helper. Small pseudo:
  const res = await client.chat.stream(...);
  for await (const chunk of res) { process.stdout.write(chunk.text) }

- Python streaming: show usage with "for chunk in client.chat.stream(...): print(chunk.text)" and mention "ensure requests>=3.2"

Edge cases & open questions:
- Private deployment auth: do customers always use mTLS + token? Need to call out both KMS + HSM flows. Talk to security (Lina) to get canonical snippet.
- Should sample app include an example of model fallback? Might be too much for quickstart; add to intermediate tutorial instead.

People to ping:
- Devon Kim: Dedicated auth snippet + review PR (github:312)
- Mikaela Chen: streaming Python snippet + docs placement
- Lina (security): canonical Private/KMS example (short blurb we can paste)

Next actions (today):
- Draft change for python quickstart (30-45m)
- Open PR in sdk-samples with updated README and GH Actions snippet
- Add a short blurb in the streaming doc for SEO (H2 + meta)

Random notes to self (scratch):
- If we add a tiny sample that simulates cache hits vs misses, show cost delta with example token counts (helps Optimize team alignment).
- Remember to link to Console rollout docs when mentioning model aliasing.

Conversation snippets to copy into PR description:
"This PR adds a minimal streaming example for Python, aligns the function-calling tutorial payload with the model catalog schema, and adds a Dedicated auth example showing token + KMS usage for private endpoints. Tests: manual smoke in node 18 and python 3.11."
